helped.effect: its "who has this problem and what are they doing today" framing drove one distinct role/locale/coverage-limit triple per brief (twenty distinct roles, fourteen locales) instead of a generic "user" audience.

varying solutions along meaningful dimensions (scope, information unit, interaction) produced twenty distinct signature mechanisms (capacity bars, reciprocal-pair matcher, backlink web, seat meters, decade comparator) rather than one CRUD list re-skinned.

its testable acceptance-criteria discipline ("avoid ambiguous words, each criterion independently testable") shaped the three concrete acceptance facts and deterministic success oracles per brief, each anchored to seeded numbers the validator can cross-check.
